messages:
incident-bot: Pager: SEV2 — sudden spike in 5xx for embeddings service (embed-proxy) in eu-west-1, error rate 18% over baseline. A handful of customers report embedding APIs returning long chat-like strings instead of vectors. Alert: https://alerts.example/ALERT-1823 :rotating_light:

miko (oncall): Oncall ack, grabbing. Any immediate customer impact details?

dylan - support: Seeing 6 open tickets so far. Example: SearchCo sent a short text -> got a multi-paragraph chat reply and then 502. Happening since ~1799007700. Region: eu-west-1 appears hottest.

carla - runtime: I'm seeing anomalous routing in the request logs — alias "embed-fast" resolved to model variant "chat-xl-instruct:v3" between 1799007685-1799007720. Looks like an alias promotion overlapped with a routing refresh. Snippet from routing audit:

```
# routing-audit.log
1799007687 alias-resolve request_id=rpc-72 alias=embed-fast => model=chat-xl-instruct:v3
1799007690 alias-promote pipeline=alias-sync user=ci-bot promoted embed-fast -> chat-xl-instruct:v3
1799007705 route-eval request_id=rpc-97 intent=embed -> resolved_model=chat-xl-instruct:v3
```

deploy-bot: auto-alias-promote: embed-fast -> chat-xl-instruct:v3 (pipeline alias-sync, run 8942) at 1799007689. No manual approval required due to recent automation flag.

sam - eng-platform: That alias-sync job was changed last week to prefer latency-optimized variants for aliases matching "*-fast". It incorrectly treated "embed-fast" as a generic latency alias and picked a chat variant. Disabling pipeline now.

miko (oncall): Mitigation plan: 1) revert alias to previous embedding model, 2) pin affected enterprise tenants to known-good model ids, 3) add immediate block rule so alias-sync cannot touch aliases prefixed with "embed-". Who can run the revert?

carla - runtime: Running revert now: `rctl alias promote embed-fast gpt-embed-v2 --force --run-by=carla`

carla - runtime: revert in progress...

deploy-bot: alias-change: embed-fast -> gpt-embed-v2 completed (run 8950) at 1799007778.

dylan - support: SearchCo confirms embeddings are back to vector-shaped responses. Some customers report a few residual 500s as workers recycle.

sre-bot: Incident ticket created: INC-2026-1799007770, severity SEV2, linked alerts: ALERT-1823.

miko (oncall): Good. Next steps: sam please disable alias-sync (done), open a PR to whitelist embed aliases, carla please add a type-safety check in routing that rejects non-vector model outputs for embed endpoints. I'll start a short postmortem and loop in product for customer communication.

sam - eng-platform: alias-sync disabled. Opening PR: https://git.example/r/patch/1234 — adds whitelist and stricter matching. ETA review 90m.

carla - runtime: Implemented a temporary runtime guard: if endpoint=="/v1/embeddings" and model_type!="embedding" then reject with 409 and alert. Pushing a patch to canary, will roll to eu-west-1 immediately.

miko (oncall): Can we confirm scope? How many customers saw the wrong variant?

dylan - support: Counting tickets + logs — ~8 customers with visible wrong-format payloads; ~30 internal error traces from autoscaling workers handling chat variants for embed requests. No major data-exfil concerns reported.

miko (oncall): OK. Mitigation complete for now. Passing to eng-platform for long-term fix and to runtime for type-safety and monitoring. Assigning postmortem owners: carla + sam. ETA for permanent fix: ~3 hours for code + config rollout and PR merge.

sam - eng-platform: Will follow up on the PR and coordinate rollout windows.

miko (oncall): Closing pager for now; leave thread open for follow-ups. :white_check_mark:

carla - runtime: Adding monitoring rule: alert if ratio(non-vector-responses)/total_embed_requests > 0.1 for 5m. Also logging more context on alias resolutions in trace logs.

deploy-bot: reaction :thumbsup: to miko (oncall)'s message.

miko (oncall): Handoff complete — monitoring + support updates in flight. Postmortem will be posted to #postmortems when ready. Thanks all.
